articles.author: Camilo  Montoya-Galvez
articles.title: ICE deports Afghans and others to Africa, expanding "third country" deportations - CBS News
articles.description: Over a 10-day period, the Trump administration sent more than 100 deportees from Afghanistan, Cuba and other nations to eight countries across Africa, according to internal government documents obtained by CBS News.
